newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran's Bandar Abbas refinery due onstream in Sept.
newsitem.headline: Iran's Bandar Abbas refinery due onstream in Sept.

text.p: Iran's eighth oil refinery, located in the Gulf port of Bandar Abbas, is due to come onstream in September 1997, the project's manager said on Friday.
Ebrahim Zamanzadeh, quoted by the Iranian news agency IRNA, said the 232,000 barrels per day (bpd) plant would process 220,000 bpd of heavy crude and 12,000 bpd of liquefied gas.
He said construction of the refinery would be completed by the end of the current Iranian year on March 20, 1997.
Iran said in August the refinery would be ready for operation by March 1997.

The refinery will produce 46,100 bpd of gasoline, 36,200 bpd of kerosene and jet fuel, 69,500 bpd of gas oil, 66,500 barrels of heavy fuel oil, 7,100 bpd of liquefied petroleum gas, 5,000 bpd of tar and 124 tonnes of sulphur a day, IRNA said.
